fn='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    from collections import Counter
    r=Counter(x for x,y in marks).most_common(1)[0][0]
    c=Counter(y for x,y in marks).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out[r]=[1]*len(grid[0])
    for i in range(len(grid)): out[i][c]=1
    return out
'''
open(base+'/task-99ba5b64.py','w').write(fn); exec(fn); out=transform(grid)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
